translation: One name is Xixie (昔邪), one is Wujiu (烏韭), one is Yuanying (垣嬴), one is Tianjiu (天韭), one is Shujiu (鼠韭). It grows in the shade of old walls, or it is gathered on the third day of the third month and dried in the shade. Also, Yuanyi (垣衣) treats sudden wind stroke with lockjaw (口噤), and metal wounds; it is effective when soaked in wine and taken.
